name: BioMotion Arena
description: BioMotion Arena is a novel evaluation framework for large language models (LLMs) and multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) using visual animation of biological motion patterns. It employs pairwise comparison and crowd-sourced human votes to provide discriminative feedback on model performance in generating biologically plausible motions.
reputation: A very recent arena-style benchmark that is still emerging and has limited community adoption outside the original paper.
notes: Collects over 45k votes for 53 models on 90 biological motion variants; focuses on visual perception of motion patterns without ground-truth restrictions.
